phases.objective: Read and validate exact durable Tenant operation, plan, run, plan-item parent, journal, and reconciliation evidence from one verified SQL composition without replaying execution.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Crash-safe Restart Reconciliation Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One verified SQL composition returns an exact Tenant operation aggregate, Run parent, ordered immutable plan-item parents, and parent-bound child evidence with one database fingerprint before any recovery write is attempted.
steps: Create the reconciler from one canonical unmounted verified SQL composition.
Read the exact operation aggregate, Run parent, and ordered plan-item parent set.
Verify Tenant context, consumed plan-to-Run binding, item count, contiguous ordinals, item hashes, and database fingerprint parity.
Reject missing, duplicated, cross-bound, protected, or non-pending parent evidence before any state transition or reconciliation write.
assertions: Factory construction performs no durable read or write.
The raw composition, pool, adapter, and SQL reader are not exposed.
Binding drift fails before Run, Operation, or Reconciliation mutation.
No adapter, provider, filesystem, shell, Route, Server, or worker call is available.
Runtime mounting, provider dispatch, and Production readiness remain false.

phases.objective: Mount restart discovery and scheduling only after dedicated worker, dispatch, migration, and runtime authorization exist.
blockers: Authority and enablement DDL remain contract-local and unapplied.
No dedicated worker or fixed provider dispatch certification exists.

phases.objective: Converge interrupted durable executions from stored evidence or fail closed to unknown_outcome without provider calls, mutation replay, or automatic retry.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Crash-safe Restart Reconciliation Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Complete parent-bound prepared, result, and readback evidence reconstructs deterministic item accounting, appends one durable reconciliation, and converges Run and Operation through CAS to completed or conflict terminals without repeating mutation.
steps: Read the exact Tenant operation aggregate, durable Run parent, and ordered plan-item parents from one verified SQL composition.
Verify operation, plan consumption, Run, plan-item count, ordinal, item-hash, and database-fingerprint bindings.
Group durable journal rows by deterministic plan-item parent and require one prepared, result, and readback phase in order.
Reconstruct deleted, skipped, missing, conflict, and deleted-byte accounting from stored evidence only.
Advance lagging Run and Operation states through checkpoint and version CAS to reconciling.
Append deterministic reconciliation evidence with retry permission false.
Complete non-conflict evidence as Run completed and Operation completed; complete conflict evidence as Run failed and Operation blocked.
assertions: No adapter, provider, filesystem, shell, Route, Server, or worker call is available.
Mutation replay and automatic retry remain false.
Run checkpoint CAS and Operation version CAS protect every state change.
Terminal replay performs no new mutation and requires existing durable reconciliation evidence.
Provider dispatch and Production readiness remain false.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Crash-safe Restart Reconciliation Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Missing phases, journal gaps, or incomplete item accounting converge active Run and Operation to unknown_outcome with still_unknown reconciliation, no retry permission, and mandatory fresh read before any later action.
steps: Read the same durable parent and child evidence without consulting worker memory or the original execution request.
Detect missing prepared, result, or readback phases and sequence gaps.
Do not infer success and do not repeat adapter mutation.
Use allowed CAS transitions to move interrupted states to unknown_outcome.
Append deterministic still_unknown reconciliation with retry permission false.
assertions: Incomplete evidence never becomes completed, applied, or automatically retried.
Provider calls and mutation replay remain false.
A terminal Run with incomplete evidence fails closed instead of rewriting history.

phases.objective: This code-only recovery slice performs no live database, provider, or Hostinger canary.
Production mounting, worker scheduling, provider dispatch, migrations, and deployment remain separately governed.
